subdivision.heading: Additional Rules Specific to Originating Applications for Judicial Review

operative_text.controlling:
3.21   On an originating application for judicial review, no person
may be questioned as a witness for the purpose of obtaining a
transcript for use at the hearing without the Court’s permission.

Defined Terms

Court Related Provisions 6.8 (questioning of a witness before hearing) Presumably R.3.21 is read as if there were a comma after"at the hearing". Judicial review is conducted on the existing record, and allowing discovery or oral evidence is exceptional.

BOOK_C.title: Limit on questioning

commentary.text: This is a common sense rule, since the record, by the time the matter reaches a judicial review, is established. Presumptively, no additional evidence should be considered on review.
